Written Offer for Qt and Qt for Python Corresponding Source Code
================================================================

This offer applies to the copy of MyWB with which it is distributed.

MyWB 0.4.1 for macOS includes dynamically linked components from Qt 6.11.1
and Qt for Python 6.11.1, including PySide6 and shiboken6, under the GNU
Lesser General Public License version 3.0 (LGPL-3.0).

Masaaki Uematsu offers every recipient who possesses the corresponding MyWB
object code a complete machine-readable copy of the corresponding source code
for those LGPL-covered components. The offered material includes the source
code for the exact library versions distributed with MyWB, any modifications
made for MyWB, and the scripts and configuration information controlled by
the distributor that are needed to build the libraries.

No modifications have been made to the Qt, PySide6, or shiboken6 source code
for this release.

This offer is valid until the later of:

- July 28, 2029; and
- three years after the last distribution of this MyWB release by the
  copyright holder.

To request the source, open an issue at:

https://github.com/MasaakiU/MyWB-releases/issues

Use the title "LGPL corresponding source request" and identify the MyWB
version, build ID, platform, and architecture shown in the application's
About window. Do not include private research data or license tokens.

The source will be provided electronically without charge. If physical media
is requested and reasonably available, the requester may be charged no more
than the reasonable cost of physically performing the distribution.

The corresponding upstream source archives covered by this offer are:

- qtbase-everywhere-src-6.11.1.tar.xz
  SHA-256:
  d9594a31228aa23ad6b531719a29b45f0f3989fe6c136d45767ea179f233c1ac
- qtsvg-everywhere-src-6.11.1.tar.xz
  SHA-256:
  7f3cf02f4824bf03c2c5859ea6db173bf1482a1daf24e6cdf7bc78cfa26a8a94
- qtimageformats-everywhere-src-6.11.1.tar.xz
  SHA-256:
  b2bf6c6845ac175ed7f819145483ba4676f617aaa6a5012c8efee63c8bbac413
- pyside-setup-everywhere-src-6.11.1.tar.xz
  SHA-256:
  6ffd9835bb0dd2c56f061d62f1616bb1707cfc0202b80e3165d6be087f3965e2

These hashes identify the exact upstream material. This written offer is
made and controlled by the MyWB distributor and does not depend on the
upstream project continuing to host those files.
